Priya: hey @maya, need a quick just-in-time console elevation for prod to run a redaction sampling for ticket T-4821. will only pull ~100 rows, run the redactor locally, then delete. requesting 20m window starting ~14:10 UTC. pod is webapi-5f6d (namespace: prod-api). using sa-log-reader. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Maya: ok — quick checklist: link to runbook, job id, destination bucket + kms key, confirm sa-log-reader is read-only, and that no full DB dumps will be created. also: will this require KMS unwrap on your workstation? :lock:

Priya: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/redact-sample  
job id: red-sample-2024-04-15  
dest: s3://redwood-priv/samples/priv-ticket-4821 (kms alias: alias/redwood-priv)  
no full dumps, just COPY of a constrained query. sa-log-reader has readonly role bound in prod. I will not KMS-unwrap locally; we'll use temporary session token via access-bot. command i plan to run:  
```
kubectl -n prod-api exec -it webapi-5f6d -- bash -lc "psql -U reader -d events -c \"COPY (SELECT id, payload->>'message' AS msg FROM events WHERE event_type='user_activity' LIMIT 100) TO STDOUT WITH CSV\" > /tmp/sample.csv"
```
I will run the redactor on an isolated hammer-machine that has no network egress except to the secure bucket. :white_check_mark:

Maya: thanks — two more asks: (1) add the ticket id to the session metadata (so audit links back), (2) paste the exact query you will run in the runbook page before starting. once that's in place i can approve for 20m.

Rick: oncall here — fine with 20m window. please mask any tokens in logs and do not leave sample.csv on the pod. I'll watch infra metrics during the window. :eyes:  

Alex: conditional approve from me assuming runbook + session metadata are present. please tag me when you start so i can sign off. :thumbsup:

Priya: done — updated runbook with the query and job id, added ticket id to session metadata. starting window at 14:11 UTC. posting the run command again for audit.

access-bot: Session approved by Maya, Alex. session_id=ses-8f3b2a, ttl=00:20, target=webapi-5f6d@prod-api, role=sa-log-reader. audit_link=https://redwood.internal/audit/ses-8f3b2a :lock:

Maya: logged break-glass entry and noted approvers. reminder to upload redacted sample to the secure bucket and attach checksum to the audit entry. :memo:

Priya: will do. will post final audit note + checksum when upload completes. thanks all. :pray:

Rick: ping me if anything spikes.

Priya: upload complete, checksum sha256: 3b7e5f... -> attached to audit entry. closing session. :white_check_mark:
